keepinventory.config.keepPotionEffects.c: Keep player potion effects after death.
keepinventory.config.applyDurabilityPena: Damage player's items with durability after death.
keepinventory.config.keepedSlots.comment: A comma-separated list of slot IDs to keep inventory, using strict format. Example: '0,1,2,36,37'
keepinventory.config.keepedItems.comment: A comma-separated list of item IDs to keep after death, using strict format. Example: 'minecraft:torch,minecraft:arrow'
keepinventory.config.keepedExperienceMod: Modifier that would be multiplied by your previous experience amount. Enabled keep experience required.
keepinventory.config.keepedHungerModifie: Modifier that would be multiplied by your previous hunger amount. Enabled keep hunger required.
keepinventory.config.keepedHungerMinLimi: Minimal value of hunger after your death, to prevent spawn with empty hunger bar.
keepinventory.config.keepedSaturationMod: Modifier that would be multiplied by your previous saturation amount. Enabled keep saturation required.
A modifier applied to an item's durability if the item is saved, when possible.
